verdict.rationale: Entrust provides a documented REST API with OAuth authentication, endpoints for creating applicants and workflow runs, webhook configuration and signature verification, and API versioning/migration guides, confirming a public, well-documented API surface suitable for programmatic/agentic integration. missing for 10: no evidence of official client SDKs/language bindings beyond mobile SDKs being highlighted for API-driven automation, and no independent third-party corroboration of API usability outside vendor docs.
